claim_boundary.cad_not_as_built_metrology: STEP geometry is the printed design authority; every physical print still requires instance IDs, dimensional inspection, run-local centre teaching, and peg-to-fixture yaw confirmation
claim_boundary.state_label_phase: upright touchdown before the 15 degree cone
claim_boundary.cone_transition_policy: the cone may cross additional contact boundaries; the complete printed tip-to-shaft frustum is evaluated at 360 command phases and kept as separate per-point metadata
claim_boundary.data_governance: real raw Bota and measured touchdown dominate; clean remains pending offline QC; holdout, quarantine, and sentinel never train

fixture_frame.name: F
fixture_frame.execution_rebase: confirmed run-start TCP XY is the M12 centre; fixture XY is aligned with KUKA WORLD XY for this campaign

yaw_contract.rule: teach the printed flange +45 degree tangent datum parallel to +X_F, making the selected peg flat normal 0 degrees in F

contact_state_definition.footprint: actual printed upright M12 tip face AF8 regular hexagon
contact_state_definition.support_surface: head OD disk minus the AF13 mouth
contact_state_definition.area_method: deterministic convex polygon clipping; head circle uses a 720-edge inscribed polygon

cone_command_geometry.semantics: conservative drawing bound only; quantitative diagnostics use conv(xy(Rz(-phi) Ry(15deg) Rz(phi) [AF8@z0, AF10@z1])) at every phase and are not touchdown-state labels
cone_command_geometry.phase_grid: 360 uniform samples on [0,360deg), matching the recorded phase-bin contract
cone_command_geometry.diagnostic_area_normalization: mouth intersection area divided by that phase's projected printed-frustum convex-hull area

sampling_design.sentinel_semantics: exact repeats of one supported and one landing-mouth-clear outer-partial clean point
sampling_design.boundary_quarantine_semantics: two supported/double and two double/outer near-boundary diagnostics
